shortDescription: Manages VXLAN tunnel configuration on HUAWEI CloudEngine devices.

options.name: bridge_domain_id
options.description: Specifies a bridge domain ID. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 16777215.

options.name: nve_mode
options.description: Specifies the working mode of an NVE interface.

options.name: nve_name
options.description: Specifies the number of an NVE interface. The value ranges from 1 to 2.

options.name: peer_list_ip
options.description: Specifies the IP address of a remote VXLAN tunnel endpoints (VTEP). The value is in dotted decimal notation.

options.name: protocol_type
options.description: The operation type of routing protocol.

options.name: source_ip
options.description: Specifies an IP address for a source VTEP. The value is in dotted decimal notation.

options.name: state
options.description: Manage the state of the resource.

options.name: vni_id
options.description: Specifies a VXLAN network identifier (VNI) ID. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 16000000.
